jurisdiction.venue: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) & Rouse Avenue Court, New Delhi

headline: At India’s Serious Fraud Office, an Investigator Offers a Private Settlement Plan
deck: The Central Bureau of Investigation arrested S.F.I.O. Deputy Director Harish Kumar Tanwar and two others in an October sting over an alleged ₹1 crore bribe demand tied to the DHFL corporate-fraud probe.
byline: By The Financial Crimes New Delhi Bureau

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Arrested red-handed Oct. 12–13, 2026 and remanded by Rouse Avenue Court; trial pending on allegations of demanding ₹1 Cr to shield accused in the DHFL probe.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: A traffic constable caught accepting a ₹2,000 roadside bribe
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Instant suspension and trap prosecution — here replicated inside India’s premier white-collar fraud agency

sources.title: CBI Press Release: Arrest of SFIO Deputy Director and Two Others in ₹20 Lakh Bribery Trap Linked to DHFL Probe
